text:
Anika: Heads-up from the usability sessions: users tapped the onboarding banner but were surprised there wasn't an immediate checklist. They expected a quick linear flow.
Sam: saw the same in the lab. The slim left rail is low-friction but people miss the checklist affordance. The modal forces a flow but feels heavy.
Raj: metrics note 12: our trial-to-active rate dipped after the rail-only rollout. Possible culprit: CTA copy ambiguity. We need to A/B copy labels.
Julia: accessibility findings: rail CTA contrast is 3.8:1 on default theme (fails AA). Keyboard nav skips the rail CTA; tabindex needs fixing.
Anika: copy options to test: "Create demo project", "Follow setup checklist", "Try a sample stack". I lean explicit.
Sam: agree explicit helps. Add microcopy: "Sandbox with sample prompts  2 minutes" under CTA.
Raj: sticky preference: if we open modal checklist for returning users, save preference so we don't keep prompting Dedicated customers.
Julia: a11y quick fixes: add role=\"region\" and aria-label to rail, ensure focus ring, and make CTA reachable with single Tab. Also bump contrast to >=4.5:1. Proposed CSS:
```
.rail-cta { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-color); color: #07204a; }
```
DesignBot: Figma updated: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/onboard-entry-rail 12 version 4 includes contrast + copy variants.
Anika: proposal: keep the rail as default (lower barrier), but add an inline 3-bullet preview under the CTA (e.g., "Invite teammates", "Deploy sample app", "Run a test prompt"). Add a "Full setup" action that opens the modal checklist.
Sam: hybrid sounds good. Telemetry events: entry_rail_cta_click, entry_preview_expand, entry_flyout_open, entry_rail_dismiss.
Raj: experiment rule: if dismissed, don't show rail for 14 days. Track dismiss count.
Julia: I'll upload keyboard nav spec and voiceover notes to the ticket. Also will attach contrast audit screenshots.
Anika: engineering estimate?
Sam: eng: ~3 days (copy + contrast + tabindex + telemetry). Flyout exists; wiring it up is small.
Anika: if under 2 days we slot it in next sprint, otherwise following sprint. I'll wait for ticket + estimates. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
